description: This is a modern pendant lamp with a unique design. It features a central, larger lime green conical shade suspended by thin wires and cables from a circular light green ceiling mount. To the sides of the main shade, there are two smaller shades. One is a lime green disc positioned to the left and slightly forward, while the other is a lighter green truncated cone tilted to the right. The overall impression is one of contemporary artistry, with a playful arrangement of geometric shapes and a vibrant color palette. The thin suspension wires add a delicate touch, contrasting with the solid forms of the shades. This lamp is designed to be a focal point in a room, offering both illumination and aesthetic appeal.
